title: Match the angel to the job
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Eeman: angels, books and Qadr
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y1 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: match the angel to the job)
intro: Lesson 16: The six pillars of eeman and the angels. To understand that Muslims believe in six things, and that angels are created by Allah to obey Him

questions.q: Say the six pillars of eeman with me, counting on your fingers.
questions.a: Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day, qadr
questions.model: Teacher counts: one, Allah; two, angels; three, books; four, messengers; five, the Last Day; six, qadr. Then pupils say it with the teacher.

questions.q: Which angel brought Allah's words to the Prophet ﷺ?
On the pupil PDF, draw a line from each angel's name to a picture of its job (an open book, a rain cloud, a pencil).
questions.a: Jibril to the book, Mika'il to the rain cloud, the two writers to the pencil
questions.model: Teacher joins Jibril to the open book: 'Jibril brought Allah's words.'

questions.q: tell your partner one good deed the writing angels will write today.
How many pillars of eeman are there?
Back to our ponder: why do we believe in the angels?
